# Test PDF Fixtures

This directory contains real academic research-paper PDF fixtures used for end-to-end (E2E) integration testing of the document ingestion pipeline.

## sample_paper.pdf

- **Title**: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
- **Authors**: Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, Jeffrey Dean
- **Year**: 2013
- **arXiv ID**: [1301.3781](https://arxiv.org/abs/1301.3781)
- **Source URL**: https://arxiv.org/pdf/1301.3781.pdf
- **Format**: PDF (12 pages, ~228 KB)
- **Description**: Classic NLP paper introducing Word2Vec architectures (Continuous Bag-of-Words and Continuous Skip-gram). Contains clear academic sections (Abstract, Introduction, Model Architectures, Results, Examples of Learned Relationships, Conclusion) and references.
